## Make sure you are on the latest version first

- Installed via AUR (`/usr/bin/vicine`): update with `paru -Syu` / `yay -Syu`
- Installed via npm / Homebrew / Nix: update via that package manager
- Installed via script/git: `vicine -U`
- Compare with `vicine -V` and [the latest release](https://github.com/spaciousejar/vicine-cli/releases)

**Metadata (please complete)**
Version: [e.g. 1.5.1, run `vicine -V`]

Provider: [server-1 hicine / server-2 popmovie / server-3 hianime, if known]
Query / command: [e.g. `vicine -D "one piece"`]
